data.body:
[P2] Persist example invocation intent before submission

The marker exists only in memory until `after()` writes the quarantine. If Jest exits after Lambda accepts Invoke but before teardown, `Cloud.restore_invocations()` cannot recover that attempt. When execution visibility is delayed beyond the quiet window, settlement can report success and admit lifecycle cases while the accepted example remains outstanding. Persist a run/commit-scoped invocation record before `next(args)` and update it with the returned ARN, using the format consumed by `restore_invocations()`. Add a regression covering driver exit before teardown with delayed service visibility.
